_comment: Speeds keep a 30:20:18:35:22 ratio, scaled so a Scooter 10 sails Rome-Tunis in about 60 s. range_nm is the longest single leg the model can sail (Scooter 10: 1 min 30 s of sailing, GE 100: 3 min 30 s, Greenline 200: 6 min, Trans Atlantic: any Med port to the US East Coast, Dominator: the longest route between any two ports). max_owned is how many of each model the player can own. map_size (length, width in pixels) and map_color are how the ship is drawn on the map. fuel_tank is in fuel units; fuel_per_s is burned every second at sea, whatever the speed. Burn is set so fuel costs about a third of a leg's pay at full speed, and tanks are sized so a ship leaving at 100% maintenance can just finish a range_nm leg while wearing and slowing on the way. wear_pct_per_min is maintenance lost per minute of running at sea (the Dominator wears at half rate); repair_cost_per_pct is set so repairs cost about 10% of what the ship earns sailing. dock_s is how long a ship unloads and loads at each port; repair, then refuel, each take refill_phase_s of that time.
